metadata.article_title: Provision of value added services through electronic form.

article.title: Provision of value added services through electronic form.
article.content:
401Provision of value added services through electronic form.

Section 401  ·  Chapter XXIV  ·  page 229 of the Act
The Central Government may provide such value added services through the electronic form and levy such fee thereon as may be prescribed.
